validation_failed.title: Please check your input
validation_failed.message: Some values were not accepted by the server.

unauthenticated.title: Please sign in
unauthenticated.message: Your session has ended or you are not signed in.

forbidden.title: Not permitted
forbidden.message: You do not have permission to perform this action.

not_found.title: Not found
not_found.message: This item does not exist or you do not have access to it.

conflict.title: Conflict
conflict.message: This conflicts with existing data, for example a name that is already taken.

precondition_failed.title: Changed in the meantime
precondition_failed.message: Someone else changed this item. Reload it and apply your changes again.

rate_limited.title: Too many requests
rate_limited.message: Please wait a moment and try again.

quota_exceeded.title: Quota exceeded
quota_exceeded.message: The quota of this product or plan is used up.

mode_not_supported.title: Not available in this mode
mode_not_supported.message: This action is not supported by the server's current mode (single or multi product).

internal.title: Server error
internal.message: The server could not complete the request. Please try again later.

network_error.title: Server not reachable
network_error.message: The Axentra server could not be reached. Check your connection or the server status.

unknown.title: Unexpected error
unknown.message: The request failed for an unknown reason.

payload_too_large.title: Too large
payload_too_large.message: The request or file exceeds the server's size limit.

unsupported_media_type.title: Type not accepted
unsupported_media_type.message: The server does not accept this content type.
